description: The Lagos State Spatial Data Infrastructure is an ArcGIS Hub site for sharing geospatial data on Lagos State, Nigeria, on the Africa GeoPortal. Its public items, read on 2026-09-28 through the ArcGIS interfaces, comprise four feature services with web maps and dashboards: 2,320 health facilities with ward, local government area, category, ownership, type, functional status, accessibility and last update; 106 police stations with names and ward codes; 6,349 survey control points with eastings and northings; and the state boundary. Coverage is Lagos State. Access is free as ArcGIS feature services; the boundary layer is licensed CC BY 4.0, while the other layers state no licence. Caveats: the health facility and police layers carry a source field whose origin was not checked, completeness against official registers is unknown, and the hub page itself renders by script, so any content beyond the 13 public items was not read. It supports critical facility exposure and emergency studies, such as locating hospitals and police stations in Lagos flood zones, or measuring travel times from communities to functioning health facilities. No related Lagos State facility record is catalogued; related resources include Lagos health facility assessments.
